[SWS_CM_10017] Deserializing incomplete data on the proxy side belonging to
a field and initValue defined
Upstream requirements:
RS_CM_00202
⌈
If less data than expected shall be de-serialized on the proxy side and the data to be
de-serialized belong to a
Field
and the
initValue
is defined, the
initValue
shall
be used as a substitute for the missing data.
⌋
